title: Enchancement Durability Pack
description: Reimplements durability for the Enchancement mod.
body:
When added to your world, this datapack will re-enable durability for all tools and armor (unless I missed any) if you have the [Enchancement](https://modrinth.com/mod/enchancement) mod installed.

This datapack is just meant to be an addon to re-enable durability for those who prefer to have it enabled with Enchancement's enchantments. I do not own Enchancement or have anything to do with the project. This is simply a quick datapack I threw together because I wanted to enable durability in my world and I figured it might be useful to someone else.

If I missed any tools or armor, please let me know in my [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/rrhTw6y7k9).
